selectedIdentity: chris_dev only; preserve Developer role and exact verified account identity
decision: Existing minimum missing capability is adjustInventory for an existing-catalog receival; no current generic per-user grant mechanism exists. Keep the canary OFF until Product chooses an explicit new permission-policy change.

whyRequired.manualInventory: The existing Add/Edit/Cancel/Clear Pending Receivals UI uses auth.can(adjustInventory). Its mutation controls also require writeBusinessData.
whyRequired.actualSharedRls: Pending Receivals RBAC INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies require has_app_capability(adjustInventory); separate restrictive business-write policies require writeBusinessData.
whyRequired.agent: Hosted authorization, runtime preparation/review/approve, source Storage guards/attestation, private draft policies, immutable approval/core execution and permit minting preserve those same readOperationalData/writeBusinessData/adjustInventory boundaries.
whyRequired.businessMeaning: This is the accepted existing canonical authorization contract, not a model limitation or routing heuristic. The capability bundles incoming-material administration together with receipt reversal; pending creation itself does not add on-hand stock.

purchasing.draftSource: savePurchaseOrderDraft calls save_purchase_order_allocated_draft; its canonical source requires createPurchaseOrderDraft.
purchasing.pendingSource: createPendingReceivalsFromPurchaseOrder calls create_pending_receivals_from_purchase_order, which delegates to create_allocated_po_receivals and po_base_create_pending_receivals. Actual cached shared definitions require adjustInventory for normal employees.
purchasing.conclusion: PO draft permission is not pending-receival creation permission. Purchasing cannot legitimately bypass adjustInventory and would add unrelated PO/issuance work to this invoice-only canary.

existingGrantFacilities.adminUserEditor: Supports fixed role/profile fields, not an arbitrary user-level adjustInventory grant.
existingGrantFacilities.criticalImplication: There is no existing safe one-row data edit/toggle that grants only chris_dev adjustInventory while retaining the Developer role. An INSERT into app_role_capabilities(developer,adjustInventory) grants every Developer and is forbidden.

adjustInventoryAlsoAuthorizes: Pending receival creation, edits, cancellation and clearing; table policy also permits deletion subject to other guards.
Undo latest received/partially received receival; this can reverse Inventory stock and transaction history under its canonical safety checks.
doesNotByItselfGrant: New physical receiving, which independently requires receiveInventory
PO drafting/issuance or Production Job management
capabilityScope.judgement: It is broader than create one pending row, but genuinely required by current services/RLS. It is reasonable for Product to separate creation from adjustment; doing so is a new authorization design, not a guardrail to remove casually.

safeChoices.result: Keep chris_dev Developer, all write-pilot controls OFF and allowlist empty; report the exact permission blocker. Do not substitute Anthony or another employee.

safeChoices.choice: Propose a time-limited, additive adjustInventory exception for chris_dev only
safeChoices.subject: Exact already verified chris_dev UUID; do not resolve by display name or grant a role bundle.
safeChoices.capability: adjustInventory only; retain existing Developer role/capabilities; no catalog-management or receiving grant.
safeChoices.window: An exact future Product-approved start/expiry; no automatic extension or reuse of a missed canary window.
safeChoices.scopeDisclosure: The existing capability applies to its full legacy Inventory operation scope and shared database during the grant, not only one invoice or TenDev. The separate pilot still limits agent caller/origin/window/exact approved draft; that does not restrict normal manual Inventory rights.
requiredImplementation: A new narrow owner-managed, auditable per-user grant/expiry record or equivalent explicit profile exception; this does not exist today. No global Developer role-capability edit.
Server-enforced expiry/revocation with current active/non-read-only checks; no UI-only or session-only grant.

Update canonical capability evaluation and safe client access projection consistently. Metadata attestors/permit minting currently read role bundles directly and must consult the same approved effective-permission semantics, without turning service role into a business gateway.

Issuance, revocation and extension must advance the relevant authorization epoch. Server-clock expiry must make every fresh capability/commit check deny; stale approvals cannot revive through a later regrant. Retain audit evidence; a new background scheduler is not required solely to deny an expired grant.
Focused real JWT/RLS/expiry/revocation/role-isolation tests and separately approved migration/release before any real canary.
reversal: Automatically deny after server expiry even if a session/UI is stale.
Explicitly revoke only that exact grant early when the canary ends; disable pilot/execute gates and remove only its enrollment.
Preserve original Developer profile/bundle, immutable operation/audit and meter reservations; no whole-profile or role-bundle rollback.
safeChoices.risk: Temporary access to existing adjustment/Undo rights exceeds the proposed one-row action and must be explicitly accepted by Product.

safeChoices.benefit: Separate incoming expectations from stock adjustment, receipt reversal, catalog creation and physical receiving.
requiredDesign: Apply one consistent creation permission to canonical manual Add, PO projection and agent/source/draft/approval/execute contracts and pending INSERT RLS, retaining existing read/business-write checks.
Leave stock adjustment, Undo, unrelated UPDATE/DELETE and receiving under their existing independent permissions.

A creation-only grant will not authorize the planned cancellation: Product must choose a separately scoped own-unreceived exact-row cancellation contract/capability or an explicitly authorized cleanup actor. Do not silently broaden all updates.

Grant the new capability only to the exact authorized user through a reviewed per-user mechanism; adding it to every Developer is not an acceptable shortcut. A new capability name alone does not solve absent per-user grant granularity.
Preserve independent manageVendorsCatalog checks for dependent new catalog material, immutable approval/current-permission epochs, RLS, source retention, idempotency and audit.
Validate legacy manual/Purchasing clients and focused database permission/concurrency/revocation behavior before release.
safeChoices.tradeoff: Narrower long-term business authority; touches more canonical contracts than a temporary additive exception and is not implementation-authorized by this analysis.

rejectedShortcuts: Grant adjustInventory to developer role globally.
Promote chris_dev to Lead/Admin silently or use a different employee/Admin identity.
Enable the pilot allowlist while removing adjustInventory checks only in the model/runtime; underlying RLS/source/permit guards would still reject, and bypassing them weakens security.
Use service-role business writes, Management SQL, altered JWT claims or model SQL to perform the canary.
Repurpose an unrelated explicit profile flag or pretend a nonexistent per-user Inventory grant toggle already exists.

rolePromotionBlastRadius.reason: A role change adds21 unrelated capabilities and removes development-environment capability; it is not the minimum single-capability exception.

nextProductDecision: Choose whether to authorize a narrowly implemented expiring chris_dev-only legacy adjustInventory exception with its disclosed full scope, or a creation-specific permission/cancellation design. Until then the existing write canary remains blocked and OFF.
